title: 2 lelaki ditahan kes rampasan dadah di premis kurier
summary: RANTAU PANJANG: Dua lelaki ditahan secara berasingan malam semalam dan awal pagi tadi menerusi Op Taring Wawasan bagi membantu siasatan berhubung rampasan dadah di sebuah premis kurier, di sini, Sabtu lalu.

title_en: Two men arrested for drug seizure at courier premises
summary_en: Two men were arrested separately last night and early this morning through Op Taring Wawasan to assist in the investigation into a drug seizure at a courier premises, here, last Saturday.
